parameters.name: DynamicSql
parameters.description:
Indicates whether the SQL is dynamic. >
Specifies whether the provided SQL ID belongs to a dynamic SQL statement.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
End time for querying slow SQL data.
This time must be in UTC format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

parameters.name: FilterCondition
parameters.description: Reference all fields using the at sign (@). For available fields, see the columns returned by the [Query SQL performance statistics](https://www.oceanbase.com/docs/community-ocp-cn-10000000001832433) operation.

parameters.name: MergeDynamicSql
parameters.description:
Indicates whether to merge dynamic SQL statements in the response. >
Specifies whether to aggregate results for SQL statements with IN clauses.

parameters.name: SqlTextLength
parameters.description: Maximum length of the returned SQL text.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
Start time for querying historical slow SQL data.
This time must be in UTC format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
